description: The file defines a Java interface named ExpressionResolver within the package org.eclipse.ditto.model.placeholders. It provides methods for resolving placeholders and executing pipelines within string expressions, including static utility methods for substitution. The interface is part of a system that processes template expressions with placeholders and function pipelines.

classes.name: ExpressionResolver
classes.description: A Java interface providing methods for resolving placeholders and executing pipelines within string expressions.

methods.name: resolveAsPipelineElement
methods.description: Resolves a single pipeline expression into a PipelineElement; throws UnresolvedPlaceholderException if not all placeholders could be resolved.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a complete expression template that may contain placeholders and function chains, returning the resolved string or special markers.

methods.name: substitute
methods.description: Performs substitution on an input string by replacing placeholders with resolved values using a provided function. Returns a PipelineElement indicating the result or failure.
